name: KARTHIK BIBIREDDY
headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Distributed Systems & Data Infrastructure | Agentic AI Workflows
professionalSummary: Senior software engineer with 9+ years building and scaling distributed streaming and batch processing systems at Amazon and startups. I own customer-facing services that handle hundreds of millions of events per day, including multi-region production migrations, tuning and scaling event-driven pipelines, and leading team-wide adoption of agentic AI workflows.

workExperience.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer
description: Sole owner of a zero-downtime, multi-region infrastructure migration for a customer-facing list-price validation service built as a hybrid of event-driven and streaming pipelines. Rebuilt the full IaC stack with AWS CDK, reduced NAT egress by roughly 90% (from 470GB to 6GB) using VPC endpoints, and lowered capacity concentration risk while maintaining 99.9% data accuracy and zero downtime on a service that processes about 200M records per day worldwide and serves roughly 8M QPS across Amazon domains.

Designed a unified configuration platform so pricing teams can manage business rules in one place instead of across code, batch jobs, and separate config stores. I owned the full architecture, including the data model and a novel versioning and cascade mechanism that lets program managers simulate and test configuration changes before production rollout. When a rule changes at one level, related parent rules update together in a single atomic change. Design was approved and is ready for implementation.

Own and evolve end-to-end reference-pricing pipelines in Spark, EMR, Scala, and streaming systems that power List Price, Typical Price, the Lowest in 30 Days badge, and Alexa Shopping price-history worldwide. Our team owns batch and event processing, computation, validation, selection, and delivery to the UI for 300M+ products, and I own these systems end to end while adapting compute logic for regional rules and compliance requirements.

On Alexa Automotive, I delivered conversational car control and Teachable AI so customers can personalize voice commands (for example, 'I am hot' or 'set temperature to cozy'). I served as SME for the offline embedded car-control skill, improved prompt quality, and built target-device resolution using a scoring and reranking layer on top of Clucene. With a partner team, I shipped C++ messaging middleware that syncs SMS and WhatsApp messages to the in-car HUD. These features launched with major OEMs including Lamborghini, Stellantis, Lucid, and Rivian.
